thesis: The refreshed short thesis is still structural AI commoditization, not solvency or accounting. Adobe is proving AI adoption—AI-first ending ARR >$650M, creative freemium MAU >100M, Total ARR $27.50B—but it has not proven that this spend is fully incremental or that Firefly inference economics preserve legacy software margins. A model-native workflow bypass could therefore invalidate the DCF Bear floor. Against that, current ARR, OCF, shrinking shares and diversified workflows do not establish any Hard Veto.

evidence.claim: AI-first ending ARR exceeded $650M and grew >150% y/y, but product composition and incrementality are undisclosed.
Total Adobe ARR was $27.50B and customer-group subscription revenue grew 14% y/y in Q3.
TTM owner-style FCF after capex and SBC is estimated at ~$8.52B (~$21.44/share on frozen shares), while Q3 diluted shares fell from 424M to 395M y/y.
Locked Bear/Base/Bull values are ~$233.72/$495.57/$817.33 versus $248.92 current price; the modeled Bear is not a liquidation floor.
Q3 cash plus short-term investments were $5.639B versus $6.363B debt; TTM OCF is estimated at $10.806B.

counterevidence: Same-definition Total Adobe ARR and subscription revenue continue to grow, contradicting a presently shrinking moat.
AI monetization is already material at >$650M ending ARR and creative freemium MAU exceeds 100M.
TTM OCF exceeds total debt, and diluted share count is shrinking rather than relying on external equity.
Adobe spans Creative, Acrobat/document productivity and enterprise Experience rather than one fatal product/customer dependency.
unknowns: How much AI-first ARR is truly incremental rather than bundled, migrated or reclassified existing spend.
Firefly-specific inference cost, gross margin and contribution margin.
Same-definition market-share/retention trend versus prompt-native and agentic creative tools.
falsifiers: If AI-first ARR remains materially faster than Total ARR while owner-FCF/share also compounds, the commoditization short thesis weakens materially.
If core Creative/document subscription growth turns negative despite rising AI usage, the short thesis strengthens.
A disclosed Firefly contribution margin near legacy software economics would directly rebut the unit-economics attack.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: No cutoff-valid restatement, auditor disagreement or accounting-integrity failure is established.
Estimated TTM OCF of ~$10.8B exceeds total debt; operations and capital allocation are internally funded.
Q3 diluted shares used for EPS declined from 424M to 395M y/y.
Recurring subscription spend, ARR and MAU growth demonstrate paid usage; subsidy dependence is not established.
AI-specific incremental ROIC is unknown, but current consolidated cash returns do not establish a structural collapse.
Total ARR, customer-group subscription revenue, RPO and MAU remain expanding; persistent moat shrinkage is not presently established.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Frozen price is below Base and far below Bull; Bull/current is ~3.28x.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Adobe has multiple major creative, document and enterprise workflows; no fatal single dependency is established.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Modest net debt and large recurring OCF rebut financing-driven permanent-loss risk; technology impairment remains a scenario risk rather than a bankruptcy veto.

key_kpis.threshold: AI monetization remains additive rather than masking core deceleration

key_kpis.name: owner-style FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: avoid multi-period contraction as AI usage scales
